**Implementation Date**: November 22, 2025 **Developer**: Senior Mobile & Firebase Developer **Project**: Beyblade X Tournament Manager (MobiCom)
---
## DELIVERABLES
### Core Implementation (2 files modified)
#### 1. **MatchRepository.kt** ✅ **Location**: `app/src/main/java/.../data/MatchRepository.kt`
**Functions Added**: - `generateBracket()` - Creates Round 1 matches with mock data (8 players) - `generateBracketWithParticipants()` - Ready for real participants (future use)
**Features**: - ✅ Random participant shuffling - ✅ Automatic pairing logic - ✅ BYE handling for odd players - ✅ Firestore batch writes (atomic) - ✅ Complete error handling - ✅ Mock data: 8 test players (Alice, Bob, Charlie, Diana, Eve, Frank, Grace, Henry)
#### 2. **Match.kt** ✅ **Location**: `app/src/main/java/.../data/Match.kt`

| Requirement | Status | Implementation | |-------------|--------|----------------| | Mock participant data | ✅ DONE | 8 hardcoded players in `generateBracket()` | | Shuffle participants | ✅ DONE | `.shuffled()` before pairing | | Pair up for Round 1 | ✅ DONE | Loop with step 2 | | Handle odd numbers (BYE) | ✅ DONE | Auto-detect + create BYE match | | Firestore subcollection | ✅ DONE | `/tournaments/{id}/matches/` | | Match document schema | ✅ DONE | All fields included | | matchId | ✅ DONE | `match_{tid}_round1_{num}` | | round field | ✅ DONE | "Round 1" | | player1Id, player2Id | ✅ DONE | From participants or "BYE" | | status field | ✅ DONE | "scheduled" or "completed" | | scores map | ✅ DONE | Initialized to 0 | | Batch write | ✅ DONE | Firestore WriteBatch | | Atomic operations | ✅ DONE | All-or-nothing commit |
---
## HOW TO USE
### Quick Start (3 Steps):
```kotlin // 1. Import import com.mobicom.s18.domanais.joshua.beybladextournamentmanager.data.MatchRepository
// 2. Call Function val matchRepository = MatchRepository() viewModelScope.launch { val result = matchRepository.generateBracket( tournamentId = "tournament_123", tournamentFormat = "First to Four" )
result.onSuccess { matchCount -> println("✅ Created $matchCount matches!") }.onFailure { error -> println("❌ Error: ${error.message}") } }
// 3. Check Firestore // Navigate to: /tournaments/tournament_123/matches/ // Expected: 4 match documents with "scheduled" status ```
---
## WHAT GETS CREATED
### Firestore Structure: ``` /tournaments/ └── {tournamentId}/ └── matches/ ├── match_{tournamentId}_round1_1 │ ├── matchId: "match_tournament_123_round1_1" │ ├── tournamentId: "tournament_123" │ ├── matchNumber: 1 │ ├── round: "Round 1" │ ├── format: "First to Four" │ ├── player1Id: "user_001" │ ├── player1Name: "Alice" │ ├── player1Score: 0 │ ├── player2Id: "user_002" │ ├── player2Name: "Bob" │ ├── player2Score: 0 │ ├── status: "scheduled" │ ├── winnerId: null │ ├── rounds: [] │ ├── createdAt: Timestamp │ └── updatedAt: Timestamp │ ├── match_{tournamentId}_round1_2 ├── match_{tournamentId}_round1_3 └── match_{tournamentId}_round1_4 ```
### Expected Output: - **4 matches** created - **8 players** paired randomly - **Round 1** matches - **Status**: "scheduled" - **All fields** populated correctly

| User ID | Player Name | |---------|-------------| | user_001 | Alice | | user_002 | Bob | | user_003 | Charlie | | user_004 | Diana | | user_005 | Eve | | user_006 | Frank | | user_007 | Grace | | user_008 | Henry |
**Note**: This will be replaced with real participants once Join Tournament feature is implemented.
---
## FUTURE MIGRATION
### When Join Tournament is Ready:
**Step 1**: Fetch real participants ```kotlin val tournament = db.collection("tournaments") .document(tournamentId) .get().await() .toObject(Tournament::class.java)
val participants = tournament.tournamentPlayers.map { userId -> val user = db.collection("users") .document(userId) .get().await() .toObject(UserProfile::class.java) userId to (user?.bladerName ?: "Unknown") } ```
**Step 2**: Use the ready function ```kotlin matchRepository.generateBracketWithParticipants( tournamentId = tournamentId, participants = participants, tournamentFormat = tournament.tournamentFormat ) ```
**Step 3**: Update UI calls - Replace `generateBracket()` with `generateBracketWithParticipants()` - No other changes needed!
---

### Manual Testing Steps: 1. Call `matchRepository.generateBracket("test_tournament")` 2. Open Firebase Console 3. Navigate to `tournaments/test_tournament/matches/` 4. Verify 4 match documents exist 5. Check all have "scheduled" status 6. Verify different player pairings on each run (shuffle works) 7. Modify mock data to 7 players and verify BYE match creation

### Total: 10 files (2 modified, 8 created)
---
## KEY FEATURES
✅ **Random Pairings** - Shuffles before pairing ✅ **BYE Handling** - Automatic for odd numbers ✅ **Atomic Writes** - All matches created together ✅ **Error Handling** - Proper Result<T> returns ✅ **Mock Data** - 8 test players included ✅ **Future Ready** - Real participant function ready ✅ **Well Documented** - 7 documentation files ✅ **Example Code** - Complete ViewModel example

**Quick Links**: - [Index](BRACKET_GENERATION_INDEX.md) - Navigation hub - [Guide](BRACKET_GENERATION_GUIDE.md) - How to use - [Summary](BRACKET_GENERATION_SUMMARY.md) - What was done - [Quick Ref](BRACKET_GENERATION_QUICK_REF.md) - Fast lookup - [Flow](BRACKET_GENERATION_FLOW.md) - Visual diagrams - ✅ [Checklist](BRACKET_GENERATION_CHECKLIST.md) - Status tracking - [Example](app/src/main/java/.../examples/BracketGenerationExampleViewModel.kt) - Code sample

1. **Mock Data**: Temporary until Join Tournament is implemented 2. **Round 1 Only**: Future phases will handle round progression 3. **Async Operations**: All functions use coroutines (`suspend`) 4. **Batch Writes**: Ensures data consistency (all-or-nothing) 5. **BYE Logic**: Automatically handles odd player counts 6. **Random Shuffle**: Different pairings each time 7. **Error Handling**: Always returns `Result<Int>` for safety

# Bracket Generation Flow Diagram
## Process Flow
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ BRACKET GENERATION FLOW │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
START │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ User Triggers │ │ "Generate Bracket" │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ ViewModel calls │ │ generateBracket() │ └───────────┬───────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐ │ MatchRepository.generateBracket() │ │ - tournamentId: "tournament_123" │ │ - format: "First to Four" │ └───────────────┬───────────────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ Load Participants │ │ (MOCK: 8 players) │ │ - Alice, Bob, Charlie, ... │ └───────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ Shuffle Participants │ │ participants.shuffled() │ └───────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ Create Firestore Batch │ │ val batch = db.batch() │ └───────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ Loop Through Participants │ │ (2 at a time) │ └───────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌───────────────────────┐ │ Has pair? │ └─────┬─────────────┬───┘ │ │ YES │ │ NO │ │ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────┐ ┌──────────────────────┐ │ Create Normal Match│ │ Create BYE Match │ │ - Player 1 vs │ │ - Player 1 vs BYE │ │ Player 2 │ │ - Status: completed │ │ - Status: scheduled│ │ - Winner: Player 1 │ └─────────┬───────────┘ └──────────┬───────────┘ │ │ │ │ └───────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ Add Match to Batch │ │ batch.set(matchRef, match) │ └─────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ Increment Match Number │ │ matchNumber++ │ └─────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ More participants? │ └─────┬───────────────────────┘ │ YES ┌───┴───┐ NO │ │ ▼ ▼ [Loop Back] │ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ Commit Batch to Firestore │ │ batch.commit().await() │ └─────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │ Return Success │ │ Result.success(matchCount) │ └─────────────┬───────────────┘ │ ▼ [UI Updated] │ ▼ END ```
---
## ️ Data Flow
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ DATA STRUCTURE FLOW │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
INPUT │ ├─ tournamentId: String └─ tournamentFormat: String
PROCESSING │ ├─ Mock Participants: List<Pair<String, String>> │ ├─ "user_001" to "Alice" │ ├─ "user_002" to "Bob" │ └─ ... (8 total) │ ├─ Shuffled: List<Pair<String, String>> │ └─ Random order each time │ └─ Matches: List<Match> ├─ Match 1: Player A vs Player B ├─ Match 2: Player C vs Player D ├─ Match 3: Player E vs Player F └─ Match 4: Player G vs Player H
OUTPUT (Firestore) │ └─ /tournaments/{tournamentId}/matches/ ├─ match_{tournamentId}_round1_1 │ ├─ matchId: String │ ├─ tournamentId: String │ ├─ matchNumber: 1 │ ├─ round: "Round 1" │ ├─ format: String │ ├─ player1Id, player1Name │ ├─ player2Id, player2Name │ ├─ scores: 0, 0 │ ├─ status: "scheduled" │ └─ timestamps │ ├─ match_{tournamentId}_round1_2 ├─ match_{tournamentId}_round1_3 └─ match_{tournamentId}_round1_4 ```
---
## BYE Logic Flow
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ BYE HANDLING │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
Scenario: 7 Players (Odd Number)
Players: [A, B, C, D, E, F, G] (Shuffled randomly)
Pairing Process: ┌─────────┐ │ A vs B │ ← Match 1 (Normal) └─────────┘
┌─────────┐ │ C vs D │ ← Match 2 (Normal) └─────────┘
┌─────────┐ │ E vs F │ ← Match 3 (Normal) └─────────┘
┌──────────┐ │ G vs BYE │ ← Match 4 (BYE) └──────────┘ │ └─ Status: "completed" Winner: G Auto-advance to next round
Result: 4 matches created (3 normal + 1 BYE) ```
---
## Match Creation Detail
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ MATCH OBJECT CREATION │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
Example: Alice vs Bob
Match( matchId = "match_tournament_123_round1_1" ↑ ↑ ↑ ↑ │ │ │ └── Match Number │ │ └─────── Round Number │ └─────────────────────── Tournament ID └──────────────────────────────── Prefix
tournamentId = "tournament_123" matchNumber = 1 round = "Round 1" format = "First to Four"
player1Id = "user_001" player1Name = "Alice" player1Score = 0 ← Initial player1Wins = 0 ← Initial player1Losses = 0 ← Initial
player2Id = "user_002" player2Name = "Bob" player2Score = 0 ← Initial player2Wins = 0 ← Initial player2Losses = 0 ← Initial
status = "scheduled" ← Ready to start currentRound = 1 winnerId = null ← To be determined winnerName = null ← To be determined
startTime = null ← Not started yet endTime = null ← Not finished yet elapsedSeconds = 0
rounds = [] ← Round history (empty initially)
createdAt = Timestamp.now() updatedAt = Timestamp.now() ) ```
---
## Firestore Batch Write
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ATOMIC BATCH WRITE │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
1. Create Batch ┌──────────────────┐ │ val batch = │ │ db.batch() │ └──────────────────┘
2. Add Operations ┌──────────────────┐ │ batch.set(ref1, │ │ match1) │ ← Match 1 ├──────────────────┤ │ batch.set(ref2, │ │ match2) │ ← Match 2 ├──────────────────┤ │ batch.set(ref3, │ │ match3) │ ← Match 3 ├──────────────────┤ │ batch.set(ref4, │ │ match4) │ ← Match 4 └──────────────────┘
3. Commit (All or Nothing) ┌──────────────────┐ │ batch.commit() │ │ .await() │ └────────┬─────────┘ │ ┌─────┴─────┐ │ │ SUCCESS FAILURE │ │ ▼ ▼ All 4 None Created Created ```
---
## UI Integration Flow
``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ UI → BACKEND → UI │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
User Interface │ │ (Click Button) ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ Composable │ │ "Generate │ │ Bracket" │ └────────┬────────┘ │ │ viewModel.generateBracket() ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ ViewModel │ │ - Launch │ │ coroutine │ │ - Call repo │ └────────┬────────┘ │ │ matchRepository.generateBracket() ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ Repository │ │ - Mock data │ │ - Shuffle │ │ - Create batch │ │ - Commit │ └────────┬────────┘ │ │ Result<Int> ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ ViewModel │ │ - onSuccess │ │ - onFailure │ └────────┬────────┘ │ │ Update StateFlow ▼ ┌─────────────────┐ │ Composable │ │ - Show success │ │ - Show error │ │ - Navigate │ └─────────────────┘ │ ▼ User sees result ```
---
## Random Shuffle Example
``` Original Order: [Alice, Bob, Charlie, Diana, Eve, Frank, Grace, Henry]
After Shuffle (Example 1): [Diana, Alice, Henry, Bob, Grace, Charlie, Eve, Frank]
Pairings: - Diana vs Alice - Henry vs Bob - Grace vs Charlie - Eve vs Frank
After Shuffle (Example 2): [Frank, Grace, Alice, Eve, Bob, Henry, Diana, Charlie]
Pairings: - Frank vs Grace - Alice vs Eve - Bob vs Henry - Diana vs Charlie
→ Different pairings each time! ```
---

# Bracket Generation Guide
## Overview The bracket generation feature creates initial Round 1 match pairings for a tournament. This document explains how to use the implemented functions.
## Implementation Status ✅ **COMPLETED**: Bracket generation backend logic ✅ **COMPLETED**: Match data model ⏳ **PENDING**: Join Tournament feature (required to get real participants)
## Functions
### 1. `generateBracket()` - WITH MOCK DATA (Current)
**Purpose**: Generate brackets using mock participant data for testing.
**Usage**: ```kotlin // In your ViewModel or Repository layer val matchRepository = MatchRepository()
viewModelScope.launch { val result = matchRepository.generateBracket( tournamentId = "tournament_123", tournamentFormat = "First to Four" )
result.onSuccess { matchCount -> println("Successfully created $matchCount matches!") }.onFailure { exception -> println("Error: ${exception.message}") } } ```
**Mock Participants**: The function currently uses 8 hardcoded participants: - user_001 (Alice) - user_002 (Bob) - user_003 (Charlie) - user_004 (Diana) - user_005 (Eve) - user_006 (Frank) - user_007 (Grace) - user_008 (Henry)
**Output**: Creates 4 matches in Firestore at: ``` /tournaments/{tournamentId}/matches/ ├── match_{tournamentId}_round1_1 ├── match_{tournamentId}_round1_2 ├── match_{tournamentId}_round1_3 └── match_{tournamentId}_round1_4 ```
---
### 2. `generateBracketWithParticipants()` - NO MOCK DATA (Future)
**Purpose**: Generate brackets using real participant data from the Join Tournament feature.
**Usage**: ```kotlin // FUTURE: When Join Tournament is implemented val participants = listOf( "userId1" to "PlayerName1", "userId2" to "PlayerName2", "userId3" to "PlayerName3", // ... from tournament.tournamentPlayers )
val result = matchRepository.generateBracketWithParticipants( tournamentId = "tournament_123", participants = participants, tournamentFormat = "Best of 5" )
result.onSuccess { matchCount -> println("Successfully created $matchCount matches!") } ```
---
## Match Document Structure
Each match document created contains:
```kotlin Match( matchId: String, // "match_{tournamentId}_round1_{matchNumber}" tournamentId: String, // ID of the parent tournament matchNumber: Int, // Sequential number (1, 2, 3, ...) round: String, // "Round 1" format: String, // "First to Four" or "Best of 5"
// Player 1 details player1Id: String, // User ID player1Name: String, // Blader name player1Score: Int = 0, // Current score player1Wins: Int = 0, // Total wins player1Losses: Int = 0, // Total losses
// Player 2 details player2Id: String, // User ID or "BYE" player2Name: String, // Blader name or "BYE" player2Score: Int = 0, player2Wins: Int = 0, player2Losses: Int = 0,
// Match state status: String = "scheduled", // "scheduled", "in_progress", "completed" currentRound: Int = 1, winnerId: String? = null, winnerName: String? = null,
// Timestamps startTime: Timestamp? = null, endTime: Timestamp? = null, elapsedSeconds: Long = 0L,
// Round history rounds: List<RoundDetail> = emptyList(),
// Metadata createdAt: Timestamp, updatedAt: Timestamp ) ```
---
## Features
### ✅ Random Pairings Participants are shuffled before pairing to ensure random matchups.
### ✅ BYE Handling If there's an odd number of players: - The last player gets a "BYE" (automatic win) - The match status is set to "completed" - The player is marked as winner - This player advances to the next round automatically
### ✅ Atomic Writes All matches are created using Firestore `WriteBatch` to ensure: - All matches are created together - If one fails, none are created (transaction safety) - No partial bracket generation
### ✅ Flexible Format Support Supports different tournament formats: - "First to Four" - "Best of 5" - Custom formats (just pass the string)
---
## Integration Steps
### When Join Tournament is Ready:
1. **Fetch Tournament Participants**: ```kotlin val tournamentDoc = db.collection("tournaments") .document(tournamentId) .get() .await()
val tournament = tournamentDoc.toObject(Tournament::class.java) val playerIds = tournament?.tournamentPlayers ?: emptyList() ```
2. **Fetch Player Names**: ```kotlin val participants = playerIds.map { playerId -> val userDoc = db.collection("users") .document(playerId) .get() .await()
val user = userDoc.toObject(UserProfile::class.java) playerId to (user?.bladerName ?: "Unknown") } ```
3. **Generate Bracket**: ```kotlin val result = matchRepository.generateBracketWithParticipants( tournamentId = tournamentId, participants = participants, tournamentFormat = tournament.tournamentFormat ) ```
---
## UI Integration Example
```kotlin // In your ViewModel class TournamentViewModel : ViewModel() { private val matchRepository = MatchRepository()
fun generateTournamentBracket(tournamentId: String, format: String) { viewModelScope.launch { _isLoading.value = true
val result = matchRepository.generateBracket( tournamentId = tournamentId, tournamentFormat = format )
result.onSuccess { matchCount -> _successMessage.value = "Bracket generated! $matchCount matches created." // Navigate to bracket view or match list }.onFailure { exception -> _errorMessage.value = "Failed to generate bracket: ${exception.message}" }
_isLoading.value = false } } } ```
```kotlin // In your Composable @Composable fun TournamentDetailScreen( tournamentId: String, viewModel: TournamentViewModel ) { Button( onClick = { viewModel.generateTournamentBracket(tournamentId, "First to Four") } ) { Text("Generate Bracket") } } ```
---
## Testing
### Test the Mock Function: ```kotlin @Test fun testGenerateBracket() = runBlocking { val repository = MatchRepository() val result = repository.generateBracket( tournamentId = "test_tournament_001", tournamentFormat = "First to Four" )
assertTrue(result.isSuccess) assertEquals(4, result.getOrNull()) // 8 players = 4 matches } ```
---
## Next Steps
1. ✅ Bracket generation backend - **DONE** 2. ⏳ Join Tournament feature - **PENDING** 3. ⏳ UI to trigger bracket generation - **PENDING** 4. ⏳ Display generated matches in bracket view - **PENDING** 5. ⏳ Match management (start, record scores, complete) - **PENDING**
---
## Notes
- The mock data will be removed once Join Tournament is implemented - The function validates that at least 2 participants are present - Match IDs follow the pattern: `match_{tournamentId}_round1_{matchNumber}` - All operations are asynchronous and use Kotlin coroutines - Error handling returns `Result<T>` for clean success/failure management
---
## Contact
For questions or issues, refer to: - `Match.kt` - Match data model - `MatchRepository.kt` - Repository implementation - `MATCH_MANAGEMENT_GUIDE.md` - Future match management documentation

### 2. **BYE Handling** ✅ - Handles odd number of players automatically - Last player gets a BYE (automatic win) - BYE match is marked as "completed" ```kotlin if (i + 1 < shuffledParticipants.size) { // Normal match } else { // BYE match player2Id = "BYE" status = "completed" winnerId = player1.first } ```
### 3. **Atomic Batch Writes** ✅ - All matches created in a single transaction - If one fails, none are created - Database consistency guaranteed ```kotlin val batch = db.batch() // ... add all matches to batch batch.commit().await() ```
### 4. **Flexible Format Support** ✅ - Supports any tournament format string - Examples: "First to Four", "Best of 5" - Can be customized per tournament
---
## How to Use
### Quick Start (With Mock Data): ```kotlin // In your ViewModel val matchRepository = MatchRepository()
viewModelScope.launch { val result = matchRepository.generateBracket( tournamentId = "tournament_123", tournamentFormat = "First to Four" )
result.onSuccess { matchCount -> println("✅ Created $matchCount matches!") // Navigate to bracket view }.onFailure { exception -> println("❌ Error: ${exception.message}") } } ```
### Future Use (With Real Participants): ```kotlin // When Join Tournament is implemented val participants = listOf( "realUserId1" to "RealPlayerName1", "realUserId2" to "RealPlayerName2", // ... from tournament.tournamentPlayers )
val result = matchRepository.generateBracketWithParticipants( tournamentId = tournamentId, participants = participants, tournamentFormat = "Best of 5" ) ```
